tools.title: GPU renderer
tools.description: The apps' own GPU renderer (mgu-render): draws them at 60 fps, beside the MGU Store's Renderer; installed with the apps

tools.title: Controller gate
tools.description: Lets the apps have the iDrive controller (tabs, page buttons, settings, Doom); loads into the HMI at the next start

components.title: Waze on cluster
components.description: The CarPlay map (Waze, Apple Maps or Google Maps) on the instrument cluster, by Robert Nisipeanu. Set the cluster's Central display area to Map view: the Waze map replaces the stock map while CarPlay streams it. Installs the Waze tool and the cluster renderer with it.
